subject.title: fix(slack): keep previews with custom outbound identity

question: Should the maintainers accept the intentional Slack message-ownership change—an app-authored disposable preview followed by a separate customized final—as the supported behavior for custom outbound identities?
rationale: Slack delivery semantics make the ordering user-visible, and the protected `maintainer` label plus assignment indicate that final acceptance requires a human merge judgment rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Approve the ownership split
options.body: Merge after confirming the exact merge head retains the supplied live Slack sequence and does not promote the preview in place for custom identities.

options.title: Pause for additional scenario proof
options.body: Request another redacted live Slack run if maintainers want explicit evidence for a different streaming mode or media-final combination before accepting the delivery ordering.

recommendation.title: Approve the ownership split
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming the exact merge head retains the supplied live Slack sequence and does not promote the preview in place for custom identities.
